title: Senior Product Security Engineer
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description_html: NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who combines an SRE’s reliability approach with strong software build and development skills. Our Production Engineering team blends software and systems engineering to design, build, and maintain large-scale GPU cloud infrastructure with exceptional efficiency and availability. We believe outstanding software is the foundation of operating production at scale, keeping services reliable and enabling developers to deploy changes authoritatively. In this role, you will reduce manual toil by building automation frameworks, self-healing systems, observability platforms, and infrastructure-as-code pipelines that support thousands of machines. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of your work, from architecture and development through deployment, operations, and continuous improvement. If you are passionate about special GPU infrastructure and the software that powers it, this role offers the opportunity to shape both.    What you'll be doing:     Design and build production-grade automation frameworks, workflows, and data models that reduce manual operational work across provisioning, patching, image deployment, telemetry, and change management at large scale.    Engage in the complete lifecycle of services from deployment to incident response and long-term reliability improvement.    Develop software tools and platforms that integrate across data center systems: DCIM, alerting and observability stacks, compute/storage/networking control planes, and CI/CD pipelines.    Monitor and handle large-scale GPU and Kubernetes production environments; apply advanced observability tooling (Grafana, OpenTelemetry, PagerDuty) to proactively detect, prevent, and resolve incidents.    Build predictive and auto-healing systems by integrating incident analysis insights into automated break-fix and self-remediation solutions.    Participate in on-call rotations and practice sustainable incident response, including blameless postmortems and systematic root-cause-focused improvements.    Scale systems sustainably through code by pushing automation and self-service tools that improve reliability and engineering velocity.      What we need to see:     6+ years of experience in SRE, production engineering, or infrastructure software engineering supporting large-scale, highly available environments.    BS/BTech in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.    Strong software development skills with expertise in Python and/or Go; ability to design, build, and own production-quality tools and services, not just scripts.    Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, Linux systems administration, and/or container technologies; experience handling large-scale bare-metal and cloud infrastructure.    Confirmed experience building data center automation tools covering OS provisioning, image deployment, patching, packaging, and configuration management.    Experience with CI/CD tooling and infrastructure-as-code workflows.    Strong understanding of observability practices: metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting design.   Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical work persuasively across multi-functional teams.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Built and delivered automation or reliability platforms at large scale. You measure impact by machines handled, incidents prevented, or hours of toil eliminated.  You address production problems as an application developer would a build: consider the architecture initially, automate fully, and improve the system before moving on.  You have a strong passion for investing in groundbreaking technology and environments where you learn new systems quickly.  Confirmed ability to debug and optimize code, reduce system-level toil, and drive measurable reliability improvements through software.  Experience with DCIM systems and asset database design and implementation.    NVIDIA leads in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Accelerated Computing. Our invention, the GPU, powers the next generation of AI infrastructure. We build systems to run this infrastructure globally. We need engineers to write software that keeps it reliable, efficient, and improving. If this work excites you, we want to hear from you.   Known throughout the technology industry as a leading employer, NVIDIA delivers highly competitive salaries and an extensive benefits package.   As you consider your future, explore what we can provide for you and those closest to you at    www.nvidiabenefits.com/            Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 270,250 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 31, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Solutions Architect, AI Factory Infrastructure
description_html: Are you passionate about enabling the next generation of AI development? We are looking for an early-in-career Solution Architect to join the growing NVIDIA AI Infrastructure team. NVIDIA is the world leader in computer graphics, artificial intelligence, and accelerated computing. We're in search of creative minds like you to help customers design, architect and implement accelerated computing data center solutions that will power workflows including AI inference at scale and physical AI through digital simulation.  NVIDIA solutions are built around industry leading AI software tools, but these tools are only as good as the infrastructure that enable the workloads. On this team, you will do full stack design including hardware architecture, workload orchestration and application performance tuning. At NVIDIA, you will be immersed in a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.     What you'll be doing:     Help customers with their AI factory journey, including workflow pipelines and performance optimization    Focus data center implementations for inference use cases, including distributed, disaggregated and scaled out workflows    Scope physical AI journeys on Omniverse, including synthetic data generation, data aggregation, application development and simulation pipelines    Lead technical sales activities for AI factories with focus on hybrid deployments between cloud and on-prem    Deliver hybrid cloud architectures for data pipelines, storage, security and user streaming connectivity    Providing expertise in infrastructure workflows, including hardware, task coordination and application tuning    Understand different solutions trade-offs and propose enterprise customers the best architecture and technical execution    Work directly with key customers to understand workflows and share feedback with internal product and engineering teams       What we need to see:     Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering or Computer Science    3+ years of meaningful work experience, ideally in an IT infrastructure or related field of expertise    An outstanding passion for groundbreaking IT infrastructures that optimize AI workloads    Knowledge of infrastructure management including Linux, Kubernetes, Ethernet networking, cloud native tooling    Familiarity with Linux system environments including using Linux for systems administration    Comfortable with Python programming    Understanding how software and hardware work together to optimize applications    Ability to work independently with a remote team with minimal direction    Outstanding communication skills, strong interpersonal and be an excellent teammate!       Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Experience with on-prem infrastructure architecture and big cloud deployments    Experience with cloud native tooling including Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm    Background in building large scale infrastructure that deliver workloads via containers    Experience developing and deploying solutions in hybrid and/or cloud environments    Critical thinking capabilities that leverage fundamentals to deduce solutions to unforseen problems      NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 124,000 USD - 195,500 USD for Level 2, and 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD for Level 3.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 31, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Solution Architect
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Customer Success    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         The  Solution Architect will be part of the  Cross Industries Solution Architecture team at LATAM level , supporting customers across different industries by designing innovative, scalable, and value-driven Salesforce solutions. This role will act as a strategic partner to business and technology leaders, driving digital transformation initiatives through Salesforce Platform capabilities, Customer 360, multi-cloud solutions, emerging technologies such as Agentforce, and the effective adoption of AI-powered tools to accelerate solution design, improve productivity, and deliver greater customer value.   Responsibilities      Serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders, leading strategic discussions and defining solution visions aligned with business objectives.    Lead the end-to-end design of Salesforce solutions, leveraging the Customer 360 vision and multi-cloud strategies.    Translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable, and value-driven solutions.    Facilitate discovery sessions and functional workshops to gather requirements, define business processes, and prioritize the product backlog.    Design and document business processes using structured frameworks and methodologies to ensure efficiency and alignment with project goals.    Provide hands-on Salesforce configuration and prototyping when required.    Ensure adherence to Salesforce implementation best practices and platform governance throughout the project lifecycle.    Lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams, fostering alignment across business, product, and technology.    Partner with project managers to provide technical guidance, identify risks, and define mitigation strategies.    Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, ensuring clear communication and high-quality delivery.    Mentor and coach Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and consultants, promoting technical excellence across the team.    Lead solution estimations, technical proposals, and pre-sales activities when required.    Lead executive-level conversations, influencing business and technology decisions with C-level stakeholders.        Experience & Skills Required      5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise-level projects using both waterfall and agile software development methodologies throughout the whole life cycle (from planning to go-live) with repeated and demonstrable success    Proven experience as a Solution Architect delivering enterprise-scale Salesforce solutions in complex digital transformation programs.    Strong expertise with the Salesforce Platform, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service and other relevant Salesforce Clouds.    Experience designing scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions across multiple clouds.    Solid understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, declarative development, and solution architecture best practices.    Experience working in consulting environments and leading customer-facing engagements.    Strong knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).    Ability to balance business needs with technical considerations, making sound architectural decisions and evaluating trade-offs.    Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.    Strong analytical thinking with the ability to solve complex business and technical challenges.    Advanced or fluent English (required); Spanish proficiency is preferred.    Experience with Agentforce, AI-powered Salesforce capabilities, and the adoption of AI tools to enhance solutioning and delivery processes is highly desirable.Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following industries: MAE/CBS (Manufacturing, Automotive, Energy / Consumer Business Services - Utilities); FINS (Financial Services including Insurance); HLS (Healthcare and Life Sciences); RCG (Retail Consumer Goods); PubSec (Public Sector, Non-profit, and Education)             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our      Candidate Privacy Statement      for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.        Posting Statement     Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.    Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.    Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Solutions Architect - Data Center Infrastructure
description_html: Do you thrive on taking a strategic product from launch to go to market at scale across the world’s largest customers? NVIDIA is seeking a hands-on, action-oriented Senior Solutions Architect to join our team, focused on the technical execution across engineering, product, and sales teams and support to achieve Hyperscaler-scale deployment for our groundbreaking data center products. This role requires a strong passion for system design and a successful history of engaging with customers on a deep technical level, preferably with direct datacenter knowledge and experience debugging datacenter platforms. You will serve as a critical bridge between product strategy and large-scale customer deployment.       What you’ll be doing:       Help architect and scale high-performance, distributed AI infrastructure on-prem or in the cloud built with the latest NVIDIA GPU supercomputers for new and existing customers.      Act as a technical specialist on GPU and networking products, directly supporting sales account managers to secure design wins.      Provide technical and onsite support to solve complex hardware and software problems, with a focus on deep learning inference.      Collect, maintain, and analyze complex deployment data and logs to assess product health, identify technical challenges, and guide the customer to resolution of roadblocks.      Actively establish and nurture technical relationships with engineers and architects at key customer accounts.      Identify customer architectures and key product requirements in the CSP/OEM AI market to successfully implement NVIDIA's solutions.      Develop technical solutions including hardware & software demos and example system designs.      Offer technical and sales training to direct sales teams and channel partners.         What we need to see:       BS/MS/PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or other Engineering fields or equivalent experience.      8+ years of work-related experience in the high-tech electronics industry, particularly in system design or technical customer support roles.      Technical competence to roll up your sleeves, look at logs and deployment data, and guide a customer to the resolution of technical issues      Expert analytical and problem-solving abilities.      Capable of excelling in a dynamic, constantly evolving environment.      Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with management and engineering teams.         Ways to stand out from the crowd:       Experience working in a Hyperscaler or Cloud Service Provider (CSP) environment or extensive experience engaging with them as a strategic partner.      Hands-on experience with NVIDIA hardware (e.g., ARM CPU, H100, GB200) and software libraries, with an understanding of performance tuning and error diagnostics.      Established track record of driving a product from the pilot phase to high-volume, at-scale deployment in a data center environment.      Practical knowledge of NVIDIA systems technology such as NCCL, DCGM, and UFM.      Knowledge of Embedded Linux Systems, APIs, and similar embedded OS.       NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 31, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
